setting: You are all members of a community choir in Leeds that rehearses on Thursday evenings in a church hall, and you have known each other through the choir for a few years. At the moment you are preparing for the December carol concert, and you use this group chat to swap rehearsal changes, sheet music, and lifts to Thursday practices.
openers: Ask who can bring the mince pies
Remind everyone Thursday's rehearsal starts at 7:30
Send a photo of the carol sheet with the altos marked
Offer a lift to anyone coming from Headingley

text: Reminder: rehearsal tonight starts 7:30 not 7. Hall's got the brownies in till half six. Bring folders, we're doing the Rutter
Ta. Still the big room or side hall?
Big room
Does anyone have a spare alto Rutter? Mine's got coffee on the second page
I have one
Brilliant thank you
Is the dress rehearsal still the 14th?
Yes 14th, 6pm at the church. Derek's driving
I'll be there
Anyone need a lift from Headingley? Can take 2
I can take Ellie, I'm going past Meanwood anyway
Ok perfect thanks
Sorry, this building is a nightmare. Client has changed the whole ground floor again
Is that the one in Chapel Allerton
Yes. They want a glass box now
Running a bit late, mixing something till 7. Will be there by 7:50
Ok
Running late too sorry, bus
Derek's at the front door looking at his watch
I am not
On my way, see you there
Home. Pauline says the Rutter was better than last week. I said it was the same
Did anyone get the Holst sheet or is that just me
Tomasz sent it round last week I think. Check the email
Sent it on the 2nd. Attached to the email not here
Sorry
Anyone know if the church piano's getting tuned before the 14th
No idea. Ask Derek, he's got the hall keys
Not me. Ask the vicar
Client's just sent a 14 page email about the glass box. Fourteen pages
Sorry
Can do a lift Thursday if anyone needs one from the Hyde Park side
I'm ok with Nadia thanks
Yes still on
Mixing a Christmas thing at the Brudenell till late. Don't reply, I'll read tomorrow
Long day. Someone was sick on the reception desk at the surgery. Not going to say more
Oof
[photo: frost on the leeks]
Is anyone else's Rutter going to fall apart before the 14th
Read it. Piano's not being tuned before the 14th. Rang the church office, they said the tuner's booked for January
Rutter's fine. Tomasz you're fretting
Page 6
Page 6 is always a nightmare. Bar 40 the altos come in on the wrong beat if you're not counting
Sorry, in the car park. Flu clinic queue is out the door
Holst is up on the drive now if anyone missed it. Did Tomasz send the right version
Yes. The one with the corrected tenor line
[photo: leeks, frost gone now]
Pauline says they're not worth eating. She's wrong
I said they were small
Brudenell was a shambles. Tell you Thursday. Anyone know if the chairs are out at the hall or do we set up
I've got the key. Chairs were out Wednesday
Client wants the glass box to be a different glass box
Not replying to that email till Monday
Ok for those of you who aren't me, I've just had a shower and I'm sitting down
The man on the desk was a lot of Stella and a row with his sister. That's all I'll say
Oof again
Derek is in the garden in the dark with a torch looking at the leeks again
Frost on them. They're recovering
Housemates have people round. Can't hear myself think. Rutter's still falling apart
Sing it in the bath
Tried that
Anyone else awake or is it just me and this email
Awake. On the sound desk at 2am making a bass line sound less like a fridge
